name: Momiji Akira
source:
"Please, enjoy your time at the café......Eh? That's so unlike me?"

[url=/c104596]Yuuki[/url]'s kouhai, doesn't participate in school extra-curricular activities and a resident of Minato Dormitory. Her room number is 205. 
She is [url=/c104591]Seika[/url]'s childhood friend and best friend.

Unlike Seika whose upbringing was wholesome and clean, Akira was the opposite with her free-spirit and gyaru-like demeanour. Perhaps it was because she took a shine to the cafe work, or because her name was ever-present on the shift roster, but she was shortly appointed leader despite only recently starting her first year of high school.

Her outfit in the dormitory is not much different from just underwear. One of her hobbies is teasing Yuuki for laughs, Yuuki and [url=/c104594]Hiiragi[/url] in turn either tell her off or are in shock at her antics. 

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/nekoking/character/akira.html]Official website[/url]]
